installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT=/mnt/server
mkdir -p "$ROOT/steamcmd"

echo "> Installing steamcmd ..."
curl -sSL https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xzf - -C "$ROOT/steamcmd"

echo "> Installing app ${SRCDS_APPID} ..."
export HOME="$ROOT"
(cd "$ROOT/steamcmd" && ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir "$ROOT" +login anonymous +app_update "${SRCDS_APPID}" validate +quit)

mkdir -p "$ROOT/.steam/sdk32" "$ROOT/.steam/sdk64"
cp -v "$ROOT/steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so" "$ROOT/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so"
cp -v "$ROOT/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so" "$ROOT/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so"

# Metamod and CounterStrikeSharp are installed here, not at boot: this container has curl, jq
# and unzip, the game image does not. Switching the framework therefore needs a reinstall.
if [[ "${PLUGIN_FRAMEWORK:-none}" != "none" ]]; then
    echo "> Installing Metamod:Source ..."
    MM_FILE="$(curl -sSL https://mms.alliedmods.net/mmsdrop/2.0/mmsource-latest-linux)"
    curl -sSL "https://mms.alliedmods.net/mmsdrop/2.0/${MM_FILE}" | tar -xzf - -C "$ROOT/game/csgo"

    # metamod only loads when gameinfo.gi lists its search path
    GI="$ROOT/game/csgo/gameinfo.gi"
    if ! grep -q 'csgo/addons/metamod' "$GI"; then
        sed -i 's#^\([[:space:]]*\)Game_LowViolence#\1Game\tcsgo/addons/metamod\n\1Game_LowViolence#' "$GI"
    fi
fi

if [[ "${PLUGIN_FRAMEWORK:-none}" == "counterstrikesharp" ]]; then
    echo "> Installing CounterStrikeSharp ..."
    CSS_URL="$(curl -sSL https://api.github.com/repos/roflmuffin/CounterStrikeSharp/releases/latest \
        | jq -r '.assets[] | select(.name | test("with-runtime-linux.*\.zip$")) | .browser_download_url')"

    if [[ -z "$CSS_URL" || "$CSS_URL" == "null" ]]; then
        echo "x No CounterStrikeSharp linux build in the latest release, skipping."
    else
        curl -sSL -o /tmp/css.zip "$CSS_URL"
        unzip -o -q /tmp/css.zip -d "$ROOT/game/csgo"
    fi
fi

# a place for own cvars; never overwritten, so a reinstall keeps it
if [[ ! -f "$ROOT/game/csgo/cfg/server.cfg" ]]; then
    echo "> Creating an empty server.cfg ..."
    mkdir -p "$ROOT/game/csgo/cfg"
    echo "// Own cvars go here, executed via the \"Config to Execute\" variable." > "$ROOT/game/csgo/cfg/server.cfg"
fi

echo "> Writing start.sh ..."
cat > "$ROOT/start.sh" <<'LAUNCHER'
#!/bin/bash
# Launcher for the Counter-Strike 2 egg. Written by the egg's install script - a reinstall
# overwrites it, so keep own changes in the panel variables where you can.
set -uo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
cd "$ROOT"

# every boot updates the server files - no toggle: a CS2 server that lags a game update behind
# refuses the connecting clients anyway. Failure is logged and the server starts with what is there.
echo "> Updating app ${SRCDS_APPID:-730} via steamcmd ..."
(cd steamcmd && ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir "$ROOT" +login anonymous +app_update "${SRCDS_APPID:-730}" +quit)

args=(
    -dedicated
    -console
    -port "${SERVER_PORT:-27015}"
    +ip 0.0.0.0
    -maxplayers_override "${MAX_PLAYERS:-16}"
    +game_type "${GAME_TYPE:-0}"
    +game_mode "${GAME_MODE:-1}"
    +hostname "${HOSTNAME:-Counter-Strike 2 Server}"
    +sv_password "${SRV_PASSWORD:-}"
    +rcon_password "${RCON_PASSWORD:-}"
    +sv_lan "${SV_LAN:-0}"
    +sv_region "${SV_REGION:-3}"
    +bot_quota "${BOT_QUOTA:-0}"
    +sv_hibernate_when_empty "${HIBERNATE:-1}"
)

[[ "${ENABLE_RCON:-0}" == "1" ]] && args+=(-usercon)
[[ "${INSECURE:-0}" == "1" ]] && args+=(-insecure)
[[ -n "${STEAM_ACC:-}" ]] && args+=(+sv_setsteamaccount "${STEAM_ACC}")
[[ -n "${WORKSHOP_AUTHKEY:-}" ]] && args+=(-authkey "${WORKSHOP_AUTHKEY}")

if [[ "${TV_ENABLE:-0}" == "1" ]]; then
    args+=(+tv_enable 1 +tv_port "${TV_PORT:-27020}" +tv_delay "${TV_DELAY:-30}" +tv_maxclients "${TV_MAXCLIENTS:-10}" +tv_password "${TV_PASSWORD:-0}")
else
    args+=(-nohltv)
fi

[[ -n "${WORKSHOP_COLLECTION:-}" ]] && args+=(+host_workshop_collection "${WORKSHOP_COLLECTION}")

if [[ -n "${WORKSHOP_MAP:-}" ]]; then
    args+=(+host_workshop_map "${WORKSHOP_MAP}")
else
    args+=(+mapgroup "${MAPGROUP:-mg_active}" +map "${SRCDS_MAP:-de_dust2}")
fi

[[ -n "${EXEC_CFG:-}" ]] && args+=(+exec "${EXEC_CFG}")
# unquoted on purpose: this is a whole argument list, not one argument
[[ -n "${EXTRA_ARGS:-}" ]] && args+=(${EXTRA_ARGS})

echo "> ${args[*]}"

# exec, so cs2 keeps the console stdin the panel sends "quit" to
exec ./game/bin/linuxsteamrt64/cs2 "${args[@]}"
LAUNCHER
chmod +x "$ROOT/start.sh"

echo "> Done."

variables.name: Hostname
variables.description: Server name shown in the server browser.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password players need to join. Leave empty for a public server.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Password for remote console. Needed for the panel console to send commands. Leave empty to disable RCON.

variables.name: Enable RCON
variables.description: Adds -usercon so the server accepts RCON connections. Requires an RCON password.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Player slots (-maxplayers_override). Casual/Competitive normally use 10-16, Deathmatch up to 64.

variables.name: Bot Quota
variables.description: Number of bots the server fills up with. 0 disables bots.

variables.name: Game Type
variables.description: First half of the game mode pair. 0 Classic, 1 Gun Game, 2 Training, 3 Custom, 4 Cooperative, 5 Skirmish. Combine with Game Mode: 0/0 Casual, 0/1 Competitive, 0/2 Wingman, 0/3 Weapons Expert, 1/0 Arms Race, 1/1 Demolition, 1/2 Deathmatch, 4/0 Guardian, 4/1 Co-op Strike.

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: Second half of the game mode pair, see Game Type for the valid combinations.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: Map to start on. Ignored when a Workshop Map ID is set.

variables.name: Map Group
variables.description: Map rotation group from gamemodes_server.txt, e.g. mg_active. Ignored when a Workshop Map ID is set.

variables.name: Workshop Map ID
variables.description: Steam Workshop file ID to host instead of the map above (+host_workshop_map). Needs a Workshop API key.

variables.name: Workshop Collection ID
variables.description: Steam Workshop collection ID to use as map rotation (+host_workshop_collection). Needs a Workshop API key.

variables.name: Workshop API Key
variables.description: Steam Web API key from https://steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey, required for downloading workshop maps (-authkey).

variables.name: Game Server Login Token
variables.description: Steam Game Server Login Token (GSLT), created at https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers with App ID 730. Required for a public, internet-visible server. Leave empty for LAN only.

variables.name: LAN Mode
variables.description: 1 makes the server LAN only: no Steam authentication, no GSLT needed, not visible on the internet.

variables.name: Region
variables.description: Region shown in the server browser. 0 US East, 1 US West, 2 South America, 3 Europe, 4 Asia, 5 Australia, 6 Middle East, 7 Africa, 255 World.

variables.name: Hibernate When Empty
variables.description: 1 lets the server idle at low CPU usage while nobody is connected. Turn off if a plugin needs to keep running.

variables.name: Insecure (VAC off)
variables.description: Adds -insecure, disabling VAC. Needed for some plugin or debug setups, never for a public server.

variables.name: Enable GOTV
variables.description: Enables GOTV broadcasting. GOTV listens on its own port, so add a second allocation for it.

variables.name: GOTV Port
variables.description: Port GOTV listens on. Must be an allocation assigned to this server.

variables.name: GOTV Delay
variables.description: GOTV broadcast delay in seconds.

variables.name: GOTV Max Clients
variables.description: Maximum number of GOTV spectators.

variables.name: GOTV Password
variables.description: Password for GOTV spectators. Leave empty for none.

variables.name: Plugin Framework
variables.description: Installs a plugin framework alongside the server: none, metamod (Metamod:Source only) or counterstrikesharp (Metamod plus CounterStrikeSharp). Installed during (re)install, so changing this needs a reinstall.

variables.name: Config to Execute
variables.description: Config file in game/csgo/cfg executed on start, e.g. server.cfg - the place for cvars no variable above covers. The install script creates an empty server.cfg if there is none. Leave empty to skip.

variables.name: Additional Arguments
variables.description: Extra launch parameters or console variables appended verbatim, e.g. +mp_autoteambalance 0 +sv_cheats 0. Note: CS2 runs at a fixed subtick rate, -tickrate does nothing.

variables.name: App ID
variables.description: Steam app id used for install and auto updates.
